# Intent fixtures

`intent_cases.json` is the golden record of real LLM outputs, generated by:

    python tests/capture_intent_fixtures.py

(opt-in; requires `.env` with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; ~40 API calls).

Commit the generated file. `tests/test_intents_replay.py` replays it in CI
with zero API calls, and the git diff after a re-capture is the visible record
of how a system-prompt change altered parsing behavior.

Queue, wishlist-removal, and scrapbook phrases are included in the live regression and
capture case list. Their provider outputs are not in the current golden file;
`tests/intent_cases.py` tracks those known uncaptured cases explicitly. Run the
opt-in capture tool before treating them as provider-verified regressions.

`tests/test_queue_intents.py` contains separate synthetic parser plumbing
checks for queue and wishlist-removal examples. Their mocked payloads are not
provider captures and do not measure live natural-language classification.
`tests/test_scrapbook_ui.py` also tests scrapbook parser plumbing with synthetic
payloads; these are not provider captures either.
